description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. M. V. D. Cyril Gunarathne Pallepola, Mr. Galapitage Laxman Kodikara and Mr. Hemaka Parana Arachchillage Uplu Shyamal Bandara from the Administrative District of Kegalle and Mr. Panawalage Nimal Pathmasiri Wijenayaka and Mr. Karandana Lekamalage Rathnayaka from the Administrative District of Ratnapura as the Members of the Sabaragamuwa Province Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in a Provincial Council due to members being elected to Parliament. It involves electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members under the Provincial Councils Elections Act. This falls squarely under election-related matters, specifically addressing vacancies and declarations of elected representatives.
